answer: Reputation decay resists sybils: standing is not won once and kept, it erodes each epoch unless refreshed by genuine work, dulling from onyx-bright to nothing. A fake farm can flash across the mesa for a moment, but every idle clone's weight thins the instant it stops contributing, scattered like a gale through dry grass. Attackers must keep each of a thousand accounts busy forever — a one-time swarm becomes a permanent, compounding bill.
